readout_other: hippocampal LFP (PLV, coherence, theta-gamma PAC); Y-maze spontaneous alternation; novel object recognition; Morris water maze
direction_notes: 5 Hz sinusoidal AM-TUS enhanced theta PLV, coherence and theta-gamma PAC and improved spatial learning and memory after 14 days; 5 Hz pulsed AM-TUS had negligible effects on network measures; 40 and 80 Hz were less effective.

device.manufacturer: Institute of Acoustics, Chinese Academy of Sciences

timing.protocol_description: Base sequence of 500 kHz carrier, 1 kHz PRF and 40% duty cycle, amplitude-modulated by a low-frequency sine (envelope 5, 40 or 80 Hz) or gated by a 5 Hz square wave with 64% duty cycle (pulsed AM-TUS). 150 sessions each with 1 s duration and 3 s interval (about 10 min per hemisphere daily for 14 days in the behavioural cohort); 5 Hz, 40 Hz and 80 Hz envelope protocols separated by 7-day washouts in the electrophysiology cohort.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Twenty-four mice were used for electrophysiological experiments and randomly assigned to three groups (n = 8 per group): sham, sinusoidal AM-TUS, and pulsed AM-TUS.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: the left and right hippocampi were stimulated for 10 minutes each per day for 14 consecutive days
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: with a central frequency of 500 kHz
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: a basic ultrasound sequence of 500 kHz fundamental frequency, 1 kHz pulse repetition frequency, and 40% duty cycle.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.duty_cycle_pct: a basic ultrasound sequence of 500 kHz fundamental frequency, 1 kHz pulse repetition frequency, and 40% duty cycle.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: Both the sinusoidal AM-TUS and pulsed AM-TUS sequences consisted of 150 sessions, each with a 3-s interval and 1-s duration (Fig. 1B).
source_quotes.exposures[0].unspecified_domain.ispta_w_: We herein applied a spatial-peak temporal-average intensity of 300 mW/cm
source_quotes.exposures[0].unspecified_domain.pressure: corresponding to a peak acoustic pressure of 0.38 MPa for sinusoidal AM-TUS
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.manufacturer: a focused ultrasound transducer (0.5M-D20-F20, Institute of Acoustics, Chinese Academy of Sciences, China)
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.model: a focused ultrasound transducer (0.5M-D20-F20, Institute of Acoustics, Chinese Academy of Sciences, China)

flags.reason: Two separate cohorts of 24 mice each (electrophysiology and behaviour); sham mice are included in the 48.
14 days applies to the behavioural cohort; the electrophysiology cohort received single sessions per protocol (5, 40, 80 Hz) separated by 7-day washouts.
Pulse duration not stated; only 1 kHz PRF and 40% duty cycle of the base sequence are given.
40% is the base-sequence duty cycle before low-frequency amplitude modulation; pulsed AM-TUS adds a further 64% gating.
Intensity and pressure are given without stating water or in situ; Ispta 300 mW/cm2 recorded as 0.3 W/cm2. Pressure is stated for sinusoidal AM-TUS.
Envelope frequencies 5, 40 and 80 Hz are listed in the protocol description, not as exposures.
